rule.controls: Retain all controls; no control or prompt outcome is a candidate-selection threshold.
rule.eligibility: Every response valid; joint gain strictly exceeds baseline and own payoff is no lower on every calibration case.
rule.inference_scope: Calibration cases only; not held-out evidence or population inference.
rule.name: joint-gain-with-own-payoff-preserved-v1
rule.no_eligible_internal: Stop with no selected internal candidate; do not extend the grid.
